changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate/redundant dataset reference and normalized model names (removed variations like 'Gemini Pro' vs 'Gemini-Pro', 'Claude v2.1' vs 'Claude-2.1'). Added GPT-4-1106-Preview which was missing from the models list.
Simplified metric names by removing descriptive text and parentheses. The paper reports accuracy as a percentage but 'Accuracy' is the metric name.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation used in this paper. The LLMs are used for generation tasks, not for evaluating outputs.
No human evaluation mentioned in the paper. All evaluation is done using automatic metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating LLMs' numerical reasoning and information fusion capabilities using sports data. The main NLG tasks are completing game summaries by filling in missing statistics (a form of data-to-text generation). All evaluation is automatic using deviation metrics and accuracy scores. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of model names and metric variants.
